carePara: The face wants wiping after a wet round so the ball comes off it the same way every time. That is it.
A cover is the difference between a putter that looks new in a year and one that does not. The head is the part everyone sees on every green.

_closeTrust: Was "Forged" until 2026-08-19. The putters are CNC-milled from a single block and nothing about them is forged; the wedges are the forged clubs. It only ever rendered on the Blade, because the Mallet overrides closeTrust with its own list, which is how a wrong word survived on a shared file.
